semantics.identity_rule: Each reusable retry policy has an explicit identity.
semantics.attempt_rule: Maximum attempts is explicit and bounded.
semantics.idempotency_rule: Effectful retries require idempotency or explicit safe-retry semantics.
semantics.attempt_identity: Each retry attempt has a distinct execution/attempt identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Retry does not bypass current authorization/validation where recheck is required.

invariants.rule: Definitions, requests, validation evidence, authorization decisions and concrete executions remain separate identities; only an explicit validated and authorized dispatcher path may create effects.
